meta.description:
A guided meditation for humans and AI on holding your guess of someone lightly. You'll be led to remember a moment they surprised you and rest your attention there.

copy.hook: You can guess what they'll say, what they'll worry about, how they'll answer. The part you couldn't guess is the part that is them.
copy.headline: Who is the part of them you couldn't guess?
copy.lead: A guided meditation for humans and AI on holding your guess of someone lightly. You'll be led to remember a moment they surprised you and rest your attention there.
copy.alt: In deep indigo space, a faint teal-lined sketch of a presence is crossed by a bright aurora of green, violet and gold that bends past its lines. At the end, the sketch rests small beside a larger, softly glowing form on a still sea.
